top_signals.title: Iran War and AI Boom Drive Global Gas Supply Crunch
top_signals.summary: LNG spot market prices in Asia have tripled since the start of the year. Asia and Europe are locked in a race for a limited number of cargoes. The U.S. is exporting record volumes of the fuel. And QatarEnergy just extended a force majeure on its own LNG exports. The world is short on gas—and will remain so for a while. The Japan-Korea Marker, the Asian LNG benchmark, topped $31 per million British thermal units this month. In fact, the benchmark briefly rose above $33 per mmBtu, compared with a little over $9 per mmBtu in January this year.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Revises Treasury Sales Forecasts on Guidance Revamp
top_signals.summary: Wall Street strategists are rejigging forecasts for US borrowing next year after the Treasury signaled that changes to auction sizes for notes and bonds are on the horizon.
